{"timeout":1733450913,"value":{"content":"

Reservations

Are there any restrictions on reserving a room in other countries?
Reservations can be made at all hotels and resorts, including properties located outside the United States.
Where can I find room descriptions?
Descriptions of rooms can be viewed on hotel-specific sites or during the online room reservation process.
What is the room rate? What taxes and/or additional charges apply?

Room rates and availability display on example.com during the online reservation process.
The total rate, including additional charges and taxes appears on the “Reservation Summary”. Rates displayed do not include charges for special requests.

Can I get my corporate rate when making a reservation online?

When available, corporate rates may be reserved online.

Payment and Cancellation

Will my credit card be charged prior to my arrival at the hotel?

In some cases, a deposit will be charged prior to your arrival at the hotel. Guarantee policies vary by hotel. If the hotel where you are staying requires a credit card deposit, your credit card will be charged as soon as the hotel can process it.

Do I need to guarantee my reservation with a credit card or some form of deposit?

Yes, a credit card is required in order to guarantee reservations made online.

Can I use my World of Hyatt points for airline awards?

You can convert World of Hyatt program points into partner loyalty points/miles with participating partners.

Do I have to send my credit card over the Internet to book a reservation?

A credit card is required for all reservations made via example.com. For your protection, the reservation processing is handled on a secured server that encrypts your credit card information.

Additional Questions

Can I check in early or late?

Requests for early check-in or checkout are honored as space permits. If the hotel you are visiting is full, we may be unable to grant your request. However, you are invited to store luggage and enjoy the facilities until your room becomes available.

How can I find information regarding a new hotel?

To view a list of properties currently being developed, please visit our New Hotels page.

Where do I send questions and comments about this website?

Please view our feedback form to share your questions and comments about our site. If you would like to comment on technical difficulties, please include a brief explanation along with the error message received.

How can I contact Guest Care Support?

To contact Guest Care Support, please fill out our online form or call us at (800) 123 – 456 78 or (402) 768 – 3210.

Weddings & Events

Create delightfully memorable experiences for you and your guests.

Enhance Your Celebration

We make every occasion sparkle

Plan your next event at our resort, where our exquisite beachfront settings, refined cuisine, warm boutique service, and experienced event management.

Weddings & honeymoons

Whether you dream of an intimate ceremony barefoot on the sun-kissed beach or a lavish resort-wide banquet, allow us to take care of every little detail, from the preparations leading to your big day.

Social celebrations

Host a candlelit engagement dinner on the beach, a milestone anniversary reception in the elegant banquet room, a poolside birthday party, a private soirée for a special occasion.

Corporate events

Whether you dream of an intimate ceremony barefoot on the sun-kissed beach or a lavish resort-wide banquet, allow us to take care of every little detail, from the preparations leading to your big day.

why us

Meetings that satisfy

Our team of experienced consultants are here to help, ensuring your needs are met and your event runs smoothly.

Food for thought

With accomplished chefs on hand, we can curate the perfect menu to feed your mind and boost productivity.

A full-service menu

From expert meeting consultants and an events concierge to on-site business support and a raft of dedicated facilities.

Tempting technology

Help yourself to high-end equipment, full tech support and free Wi-Fi access for you and your guests.

Meet responsibly

Book a meeting that gives back, we have all the ingredients to make your meetings a success.
